title: Profile correction gate
statement: Let $a\colon\mathbb{N}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a sign sequence and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Define a constant Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$: its value is $−1$ if $a(i+1)=a(i)$, and is $a(i+1)$ otherwise.
